# Linked Incus evidence

<!-- Generated by `mix macus.incus.evidence` from the locked opsmaru_incus package. Do not edit. -->

The shared client Macus links is the `:opsmaru_incus` package. This
page records that the evidence the package ships is exactly the locked
package's, is well formed and self-consistent for the pinned reference,
and is linked to Macus's consumer bindings, independently from Macus's
own consumer and proxy reports. See [the shared Incus client](incus-client.md)
for who owns which evidence and [coverage](incus-coverage.md) for how
much of the reference the library covers.

## Evidence classes

Four classes of evidence, kept distinct by `Macus.Incus.Evidence` and
`Macus.Incus.Coverage.substitute?/1`; one class never counts as
another, and substituting one for another fails the check.

| Class | What it is | Where it lives |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Library | Client, gateway and operation evidence the package ships, at the locked reference | `priv/incus/*.json` in the locked package |
| Consumer | Macus's binding tests over its own `incus.sock` | `server/test/macus/incus/`, `server/test/macus/mcp/`, `server/test/macus_web/` |
| Relay | Native gateway relay fixtures, through the Macus listener with the official client | `server/test/macus/proxy/`, `server/test/macus/incus/reference_wire_test.exs`, the library's `test/gateway_*` |
| Hardware | Real guest workloads through an installed Macus | [Acceptance](acceptance.md); opt-in transcripts under `docs/testing/` |

## Linked bindings

Every binding Macus's code makes into the shared library, the library
requirement or evidence class whose evidence backs it, and the
library MFAs Macus's compiled code calls under it. The call set is
read out of the compiled modules, so aliases, imports, pipes and
multi-line calls all count: every one of the `19`
calls is covered by exactly one entry, an entry never lists an MFA no
Macus code calls, and a binding with no library evidence fails
`mix macus.incus.evidence --check`.

| Macus binding | Library evidence | Library MFAs Macus's code calls |
| --- | --- | --- |
| owner's incus.sock connection and trusted host context (Macus.MCP.IncusHost.client/1, Macus.Proxy.Host) | `helper:connect` | `Opsmaru.Incus.Connection.unix!/2`, `Opsmaru.Incus.Context.new!/1`, `Opsmaru.Incus.connect/2` |
| client workers (Macus.Incus.run/3) | `helper:connect` | `Opsmaru.Incus.ClientSupervisor.async/2`, `Opsmaru.Incus.ClientSupervisor.child_spec/1` |
| MCP operation search (Macus.MCP.IncusHost.search/1) | `GetInstance` | `Opsmaru.Incus.Operations.Composite.fetch/1` |
| MCP operation execute, composite (Macus.Dex.IncusExecutor) | `GetInstance` | `Opsmaru.Incus.Operations.Composite.run/3` |
| MCP operation execute, native (Macus.Dex.NativeExecutor) | operation documents and the endpoint-inventory ledger | `Opsmaru.Incus.Operations.Native.run/3` |
| MCP operation catalogue (Macus.MCP.Manifest) | operation documents and the endpoint-inventory ledger | `Opsmaru.Incus.Operations.Composite.openapi/0`, `Opsmaru.Incus.Operations.Native.openapi/0` |
| linked-evidence introspection (Macus.Incus.Evidence) | operation documents and the endpoint-inventory ledger | `Opsmaru.Incus.Operations.Composite.all/0`, `Opsmaru.Incus.Operations.Composite.unavailable/0`, `Opsmaru.Incus.Operations.Evidence.lookup/1`, `Opsmaru.Incus.Operations.Native.unavailable/0` |
| endpoint-inventory diff (Mix.Tasks.Macus.Incus.Coverage) | operation documents and the endpoint-inventory ledger | `Opsmaru.Incus.Inventory.diff/2` |
| private gateway relay (Macus.Proxy, Macus.Proxy.Host, MacusWeb.Router) | relay class; the gateway-transfer record | `Opsmaru.Incus.Connection.project/2`, `Opsmaru.Incus.Gateway.Plug.init/0`, `Opsmaru.Incus.Gateway.new!/1`, `Opsmaru.Incus.raw_query/5` |
| server information, readiness and extension checks (Opsmaru.Incus.has_extension?/2) | `helper:connect` | _consumer tests only_ |
| typed method calls with member selection (Opsmaru.Incus.call/4) | `GetInstance` | _consumer tests only_ |
| instance file reads (Opsmaru.Incus.Files.read/4) | `helper:read` | _consumer tests only_ |
| instance file creates (Opsmaru.Incus.Files.create/5) | `helper:create` | _consumer tests only_ |
| instance backup downloads (Opsmaru.Incus.Files.backup_download/4) | `helper:backup_download` | _consumer tests only_ |

## Library operations Macus does not expose

Operations the library marks unavailable; Macus's MCP catalogue never
lists them, and exposing one fails the check.

| `incus_instance_rename` | opsmaru_incus | deferred by scope (2026-11-04): copy and migration are not in the initial catalogue |

| `incus_native_create_cluster_member` | opsmaru_incus_native | issues a cluster member join token, which is a credential |
| `incus_native_create_image_secret` | opsmaru_incus_native | issues an image download secret, which is a credential |
